ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel regions corresponding to scarring and abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-toned contiguous pigmentation across the visible fluke surface. Interspersed with high-contrast white linear and circular clusters distributed across both lobes, with higher frequency of white pixels on the distal sections.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations visible along the upper edge of both lobes. Significant jaggedness and low-amplitude pixel variations (peaks and valleys) characterize the boundary against the sky/water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the partially submerged center, transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of small, circular, high-intensity white spots scattered across the dark surface of both lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe distal region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel streaks (rake marks) crossing the dark background across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including both parallel linear rake marks and circular white barnacle attachment scars across the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged edge on the right distal tip with several deep indentations not mirrored on the left lobe.
